planets.name: TOI-1846 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1846 with a 3.93-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-1846 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1846. Its orbit and size follow Soubkiou et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
